points.description: States that objects are initialized by constructors (a constructor, the special member function of the class), using the term 'constructor'.
points.partial_credit: Award 1.75 if it clearly names a special member function called when the object is created but does not use the term 'constructor' precisely.

points.description: States that the constructor is invoked automatically at the time the object is created.

rubric.notes: Full marks need the precise term "constructor" as the means of initialization, plus the statement that it runs automatically when the object is created. Answers that only say "by initializing values", "by assignment" or name init functions, or that name something else such as a destructor, earn nothing for P1. Saying a wrong thing (e.g. initialization by destructor or by copy only) loses the point.
